# ScaleProof

> Self-hosted tool that turns backend load tests into reproducible, safety-checked experiments. It validates before traffic, runs k6 under enforced caps, normalizes evidence, gates comparisons on compatibility, and emits evidence-backed findings and JSON/Markdown reports. Stack: .NET 10, ASP.NET Core, PostgreSQL, k6, OpenTelemetry, React 19. Status: specs ahead of code; current milestone M0.

Start with AGENTS.md for working rules. Normative behavior is in docs/specs. If documents conflict, the precedence is: Accepted ADR > docs/specs > docs/architecture.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): entry point; rules, reading paths, documentation map, ADR index, open questions
- [Glossary](docs/glossary.md): exact meaning of lifecycle, qualityStatus, outcome, severity, confidence
